note: Meta Social Connectedness Index, country level, HDX release (Facebook users active in the 30 days before 25 Jan 2026 with more than 20 friends). Values are the published scaled SCI divided by the median of all 178×177 country pairs (1424), so 1 = a typical pair and 1,000 = a thousand times as likely that two users are Facebook friends. No data for countries where Facebook is blocked or little used (e.g. China, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Turkmenistan), for Palestine or for some small territories.
label: Social connectedness index
